boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Elon University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe campus and nearby destinations with publicly documented evening or overnight availability.

cards.title: Lakeside Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Global Neighborhood · Elon campus
cards.notes: Check the current dining calendar before leaving; documented late-night service has run from 10 p.m. to 3 a.m. on selected nights.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining hall with documented overnight late-night service on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s published dining information lists Lakeside Dining Hall late-night service from 10:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday during Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Published Elon hours list Friday and Saturday late-night service at Lakeside from 10:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m.; verify the live dining schedule for the date.

cards.title: Flat Out
cards.subtitle: Global Neighborhood · Elon campus
cards.notes: Use the dining site to confirm the day’s service, then head to the Global Neighborhood retail location for a late campus meal.
cards.short_summary: A Global Neighborhood retail dining stop with documented 1 a.m. closing on listed days.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s published dining information lists Flat Out open until 1:00 a.m. Friday through Sunday during Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: The Elon-published schedule lists Flat Out until 1:00 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday; confirm current operating hours before going.

cards.title: Qdoba Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: Daniel Commons · Danieley Neighborhood
cards.notes: Confirm service before the walk to Daniel Commons; the Elon dining listing documents 1 a.m. availability on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Daniel Commons restaurant with documented late service on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s published dining information lists Qdoba Mexican Grill open until 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday during Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: The Elon-published schedule lists Qdoba until 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; its official location page identifies it in Daniel Commons. Verify current hours.

cards.title: Acorn Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: Belk Library · Elon campus
cards.notes: Check the dining schedule, then use this library café for coffee, pastries, sandwiches, and snacks during listed late service.
cards.short_summary: A Belk Library café with documented 1 a.m. service on listed weekend days.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon’s published dining information lists Acorn Coffee Shop open until 1:00 a.m. Friday through Sunday during Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: The Elon-published schedule lists Acorn until 1:00 a.m. Friday through Sunday; its official dining page places it in Belk Library. Verify current hours.

cards.title: Pandora’s Pies
cards.subtitle: 130 N. Williamson Avenue · Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Confirm the day’s closing time before walking downtown; the university’s current visitor listing documents 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Elon pizza stop with documented 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University’s dining guide lists Pandora’s Pies at 130 N. Williamson Avenue open until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Elon’s published guide lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; confirm current hours directly before visiting.

cards.title: Smitty’s Homemade Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: 130 N. Williamson Avenue · Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Use the shop’s location page to check the evening before you go; the Elon store lists service into the evening most open days.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown Elon ice-cream shop with official evening closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Smitty’s official page lists its Elon location at 130 N. Williamson Avenue and lists closing at 8:30 p.m. Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: About | Smitty’s Ice Cream
cards.access_notes: The official Elon location schedule lists 1:00–8:30 p.m. Tuesday through Sunday and Monday closed; check for day-specific updates.

cards.title: Simply Thai and Sushi
cards.subtitle: 2041 Timberline Station Drive · Elon
cards.notes: Plan for an evening meal and verify the day’s schedule first; Elon’s published guide lists Friday and Saturday service until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An Elon restaurant with documented 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University’s dining guide lists Simply Thai and Sushi at 2041 Timberline Station Drive open until 10:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Dining Options | Family Weekend | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Elon’s published guide lists Friday and Saturday service until 10:00 p.m.; verify current hours with the restaurant before heading over.

cards.title: The Root Trackside
cards.subtitle: 110 W. Lebanon Avenue · Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering or dine-in option after confirming the evening schedule; its official site lists 9 p.m. closing Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Elon restaurant with official 9 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Root Trackside’s official website lists Tuesday through Saturday dinner hours from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. at 110 W. Lebanon Avenue in Elon.
cards.source_title: The Root Trackside
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official site lists Tuesday–Saturday dinner service ending at 9:00 p.m.; check the site before departing for any schedule changes.

cards.title: Moseley Center
cards.subtitle: Elon campus · 100 Campus Drive
cards.notes: Use the building as a late campus destination for scheduled student programming or common-area time, and follow posted access rules.
cards.short_summary: The student center has documented semester building hours extending to 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University lists Moseley Center semester hours through 1:00 a.m. Monday through Saturday and through midnight Sunday.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Published semester building hours are Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m., and Sunday 11:00 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Carol Grotnes Belk Library
cards.subtitle: Elon campus · 100 Campus Drive
cards.notes: Check the library’s current access guidance, bring what you need, and use its documented overnight hours for a late study stop.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with documented 24-hour weekday access during the published schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University’s Homecoming resources list Belk Library as open 24 hours Monday through Thursday, with Sunday hours extending overnight.
cards.source_title: Elon Resources | Homecoming | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Elon’s published schedule lists Belk Library open 24 hours Monday–Thursday, Friday until 9:00 p.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m., and Sunday 10:00 a.m.–overnight; verify access rules.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus recreation and cultural options for current Elon students; bring your Phoenix Card and use posted open hours.

cards.title: Koury Athletic Center open recreation
cards.subtitle: 104 E. Haggard Ave. · Elon campus
cards.notes: Meet at the welcome desk with your Phoenix Card, then choose an open recreation space together. Check the current facility schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: One building with courts, fitness areas, studios and a pool.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that current students have access to every campus recreation facility during regular operating hours; Koury includes fitness, basketball, racquetball, studios and a pool.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card. Equipment for Koury spaces can be rented free from staffed desks.

cards.title: Swim at Beck Pool
cards.subtitle: Inside Koury Athletic Center · Elon campus
cards.notes: Bring your Phoenix Card and confirm the pool’s open-recreation window before you go. Plan a low-key swim session rather than assuming lap lanes are available.
cards.short_summary: A 25-meter indoor pool used for open recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies Beck Pool as a 25-meter indoor pool that mainly functions as an open recreation pool, and current students have recreation-facility access during regular hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card and check pool availability first.

cards.title: Shoot hoops at PARC Gym
cards.subtitle: Phoenix Activities & Recreation Center · 700 E. Haggard Ave.
cards.notes: Use the gym during open recreation and borrow a ball on site if available. Check the schedule first because the courts also host larger campus events.
cards.short_summary: Two courts for basketball or volleyball in the PARC.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon says the PARC Gym has two basketball or volleyball courts, with basketballs and volleyballs available for rent during open recreation; current students have recreation-facility access.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card and verify open-recreation availability.

cards.title: Set up a game at South Gym
cards.subtitle: 329 S. Antioch Ave. · Elon campus
cards.notes: Check whether a court is open, then bring a small group for pickleball, badminton, futsal or basketball. Follow the facility’s current equipment and check-in rules.
cards.short_summary: Indoor spaces that can be configured for several court sports.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon describes South Gym as spaces for indoor soccer/futsal, hockey, pickleball, badminton and basketball, and says current students have access to recreation facilities during regular hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card and check the facility schedule.

cards.title: Play in the Esports Room
cards.subtitle: First floor, Sato Commons · Elon campus
cards.notes: Bring your Phoenix Card and university login for an open-rec session. Check the posted weekly schedule because club practices, events and tournaments can limit access.
cards.short_summary: A student gaming room with 12 PCs and multiple consoles.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon says all currently enrolled students may use the Esports Room during posted open-recreation hours, regardless of experience level or club membership.
cards.source_title: Esports Room | Campus Recreation | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Current Elon students only during posted open-rec hours; Phoenix Card check-in and university credentials are required. Guests are not permitted.

cards.title: Try the Outdoor Fitness Court
cards.subtitle: Innovation Quad / East Haggard Avenue · Elon campus
cards.notes: Meet by the seven stations and choose a circuit that fits the group. Scan the court’s QR code for workout guidance, or use the equipment at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor bodyweight court with seven workout stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon reports that the Outdoor Fitness Court is currently open for use and has seven stations with more than 30 pieces of bodyweight equipment.
cards.source_title: Grand opening for outdoor fitness court celebrates new workout options | Today at Elon
cards.access_notes: Located along East Haggard Avenue; Elon states it is open for use. Use the equipment as directed.

cards.title: Use Jordan Gym at Koury
cards.subtitle: Koury Athletic Center · Elon campus
cards.notes: Check the recreation calendar for an unreserved window before making plans. Arrive with your Phoenix Card and choose a simple court activity your group can join.
cards.short_summary: A named Koury court space available through Campus Recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon lists Koury Center’s Jordan Gym among its campus recreation spaces and says current students have access to every recreation facility during regular operating hours.
cards.source_title: Facilities Policies & Procedures | Campus Recreation | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card. Reservations may affect availability.

cards.title: Rally on Koury’s racquetball courts
cards.subtitle: Koury Athletic Center · Elon campus
cards.notes: Ask the staffed desk about court availability and free equipment checkout, then set a short rally goal. Confirm any reservation requirements before starting a game.
cards.short_summary: Named racquetball courts inside the Koury Athletic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon lists racquetball courts at Koury and says needed equipment for Koury spaces can be rented free at staffed desks; current students have facility access during regular hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card and ask the staffed desk about equipment and court availability.

cards.title: Use the Pilates Studio
cards.subtitle: Koury Athletic Center · Elon campus
cards.notes: Look for an open window or a listed class, then check in with your Phoenix Card. Keep plans flexible because studio schedules and classes can change during the term.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated studio within Koury’s recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon lists a Pilates studio among Koury Athletic Center’s recreation spaces and says current students have access to every recreation facility during regular operating hours.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Facilities | Elon University
cards.access_notes: For current Elon students during regular operating hours; present a Phoenix Card and confirm whether the studio is scheduled for a class.

cards.title: Join a Group Exercise class
cards.subtitle: Koury Athletic Center and Koury West Lawn · Elon campus
cards.notes: Pick a class from the current schedule and register online, in the RecWell app or in person before it begins. Bring your Phoenix Card and arrive ready to participate.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled campus classes, including yoga, cycling, Pilates and strength formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon states that its 25–30 weekly group exercise classes during the academic year are free for students, faculty and staff, with registration required for each class.
cards.source_title: Group Exercise | Campus Recreation | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Free for Elon students; registration is required and opens seven days before each class. Locations vary by class.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations around Downtown Elon’s W. Haggard Avenue, W. Lebanon Avenue, and N. Williamson Avenue corridor.

cards.title: C&R Ski/Outdoor for outdoor gear
cards.subtitle: W. Haggard Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Walk to 512 W. Haggard Ave. to browse the store’s footwear, Elon merchandise, snowboards, and seasonal outdoor inventory.
cards.short_summary: A named retail stop on the west end of the downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: C&R Ski/Outdoor lists its Elon location at 512 W. Haggard Ave. and identifies footwear, Elon merchandise, and snowboards among its offerings.
cards.source_title: C&R Ski/Outdoor
cards.access_notes: Retail purchase required for merchandise.

cards.title: The Root Trackside for made-from-scratch food
cards.subtitle: W. Lebanon Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Head to 110 W. Lebanon Ave. for dine-in or takeout; check the specials board or online ordering page before choosing.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant stop with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Root Trackside lists 110 W. Lebanon Ave., Elon, and says it offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and made-from-scratch food.
cards.source_title: The Root Trackside
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; the business posts current service hours online.

cards.title: TANGENT for scratch-made dining
cards.subtitle: W. Lebanon Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Use the address at 116 W. Lebanon Ave. to find this dining stop, then consult its current menu before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant address in the compact downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University lists TANGENT Eat + Bar at 116 W. Lebanon Ave. and describes it as serving thoughtfully created, scratch-made food and drink.
cards.source_title: Things To Do Around Town | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required.

cards.title: Mediterranean Deli for a deli-and-bakery stop
cards.subtitle: N. Williamson Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Find the Elon location at 116 N. Williamson Ave.; its official location page says it has served the Elon community since 2018.
cards.short_summary: A named Mediterranean deli, bakery, and catering destination near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mediterranean Deli’s official location page places its Elon business at 116 N. Williamson Ave. and states it has served the Elon community since 2018.
cards.source_title: Mediterranean Deli location
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required.

cards.title: All That JAS for customizable apparel
cards.subtitle: N. Williamson Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Stop at 108 N. Williamson Ave. to browse gifts and accessories or ask about custom tees, screen printing, embroidery, and monogramming.
cards.short_summary: A named local boutique focused on apparel, gifts, and customization.
cards.evidence_claim: All That JAS identifies its primary Elon location as 108 N. Williamson Ave. and describes custom apparel, gifts, screen printing, embroidery, and monogramming.
cards.source_title: All That JAS | LinkedIn
cards.access_notes: Retail purchase required for merchandise and services.

cards.title: Smitty’s for homemade ice cream
cards.subtitle: N. Williamson Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Visit the Elon shop at 130 N. Williamson Ave. and check the current shop hours before heading out for a frozen treat.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream-shop destination on the north end of Williamson Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Smitty’s official site lists its Elon shop at 130 N. Williamson Ave. and says the business makes homemade ice cream in small batches.
cards.source_title: About | Smitty's Ice Cream
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; current hours are posted by the business.

cards.title: Pandora’s Pies for pizza
cards.subtitle: N. Williamson Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Locate this pizza stop at 130 N. Williamson Ave.; check the restaurant directly for menu and service details before going.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown pizza destination sharing the Town Center address.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon News Network identifies Pandora’s Pies as a downtown Elon business and reports that its menu is made from scratch, including pizza dough prepared in-house.
cards.source_title: Pandora’s Pies is ‘Best Of’ across 4 categories | The Pendulum
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required.

cards.title: Simply Oak Boutique for clothing
cards.subtitle: W. Lebanon Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Use 108 W. Lebanon Ave. as the storefront destination and browse the boutique’s clothing selection during its posted opening times.
cards.short_summary: A named clothing boutique in the downtown retail cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University includes Simply Oak Boutique among Downtown Elon shopping destinations.
cards.source_title: Shopping & Dining Elon | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Retail purchase required for merchandise.

cards.title: Town Hall for a civic landmark
cards.subtitle: S. Williamson Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Use Town Hall at 104 S. Williamson Ave. as a visible civic anchor when orienting yourself along the downtown Williamson corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named municipal destination just south of the campus-adjacent retail cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University’s partners page lists the Town of Elon at 104 S. Williamson Avenue, Elon, NC.
cards.source_title: Our Proud Elon Partners | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Government office; confirm public counter access with the Town before a specific visit.

cards.title: Station at Mill Point for the depot building
cards.subtitle: W. Lebanon Avenue corridor, Downtown Elon
cards.notes: Look for the named Station at Mill Point complex near downtown’s rail-side blocks; use it as a distinctive built landmark on a walk.
cards.short_summary: A named station/depot complex at the edge of the downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon University’s building legend identifies Station at Mill Point and separately identifies its depot/pool component.
cards.source_title: Building Legend Physical Street Addresses | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Observe the exterior from public streets; access to residential or amenity areas may be restricted.
